changes.comment: PR #455 review round: `plugin/loader.ts`'s `constructPlugin` now validates a factory-returned plugin `name` against a safe single-segment pattern (1-64 ASCII letters/digits/dot/underscore/dash, starting with a letter or digit) and fails loading with `PluginLoadError` otherwise. `pluginStateDir` now uses `name` verbatim as the `state/plugins/<name>` directory segment instead of running it through the lossy teammate-name sanitizer, which mapped both `@acme/tool` and the unrelated `_acme_tool` to `state/plugins/_acme_tool` and passed `.`/`..` through unchanged (resolving up out of `state/plugins/`). Every built-in plugin name already conforms; a third-party `npm:` plugin whose factory returns a name outside this pattern now fails `dreamux serve` at load instead of silently sharing or escaping another plugin's state directory.
